digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery (async, library, MCP paths)
propositions: A declined tickets-branch push fails to deliver warnings on async, library, and MCP write paths because the child process stderr is discarded, no logging handler is installed, and the agent reads only tool results, not server stderr
The contract "a failed push never fails the caller" requires a durable signal, not an exception or exit code, to make rejection observable on all surfaces
A durable marker in the git dir records terminal push failures at the single _raise_if_strict choke point and is read by rebar.push_status() and MCP push_status output fields
Non-failure reasons (push-disabled, async-delivery-unobservable, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) are excluded from recording to prevent alarm fatigue in local-only stores

The fix clears the marker on successful push, exposes status via rebar.push_status() for library callers and via push_status field on ten MCP write-tool results, and preserves the best-effort contract
